decisions.scenario: Switching from unavailable cheap Malaysian food to a cheap Italian restaurant and getting Zizzi Cambridge contact details

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Hello. I am looking for a cheap restaurant that serves Malaysian food.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: I’m sorry, but there are no matches for cheap Malaysian food.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I don’t have an area preference.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Zizzi Cambridge is a cheap Italian restaurant in the centre of the city.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Could I have the address and phone number, please?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Zizzi Cambridge is at 47–53 Regent Street, and the phone number is 01223 365599.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: You’re welcome. Have a great day.

decisions.notes: Retained because Zizzi Cambridge at 47–53 Regent Street with phone number 01223 365599 adds source-backed restaurant contact coverage not present in the existing reviewed dialogue corpus.
